items.headline: U.S. Futures Mixed Amid Volatile Oil Prices and Ongoing US-Iran Talks
items.summary: U.S. stock futures showed a mixed performance on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, as investors monitored evolving diplomatic discussions between the U.S. and Iran, which continued to influence oil price volatility. The Nasdaq Composite closed at a record high in the previous session, while the S&P 500 remained within 0.7% of its all-time peak. The OECD's latest report indicated global economic growth is proving more resilient than anticipated, partly due to strong AI-related investment, despite persistent geopolitical tensions and elevated energy costs.

items.headline: OECD Raises 2026 Global Growth Forecast Amid Resilience
items.summary: The Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) upgraded its forecast for global economic output, now expecting a 2.9% increase in 2026, up from 2.8% in June. The report noted that strong AI-driven investment in the U.S. and other economies is bolstering growth, cushioning the effects of the Middle East conflict. However, it warned that prolonged high energy prices and potential El Nino weather patterns could weaken growth in 2027. Consumer-price inflation across G20 economies is projected to average 4.1% this year.

items.headline: U.S. Treasury Yields Edge Higher on Hawkish Fed Outlook
items.summary: The benchmark U.S. 10-year Treasury yield traded near 4.95% on Wednesday, fueled by expectations of further rate hikes from the Federal Reserve. This follows the Fed's first interest rate increase since 2023, delivered last week. Elevated yields contribute to higher borrowing costs for consumers across mortgages, auto loans, and credit cards.

items.headline: Oil Prices Fluctuate Amid US-Iran Diplomatic Engagements
items.summary: Oil prices experienced volatility on Wednesday morning as U.S.-Iran talks at the United Nations General Assembly introduced uncertainty. President Trump described a three-hour meeting with Iranian representatives as 'very good' but had earlier cautioned of a 'big decision' regarding a potential deal or 'annihilation'. Brent crude traded near $99.54 a barrel, and West Texas Intermediate (WTI) was at $93.58. Reports of Saudi Arabia restoring its East-West pipeline also contributed to dampening oil prices.

items.headline: Major Companies Report Earnings; General Mills Sees EPS Decline
items.summary: Several notable companies are scheduled to report earnings today, including General Mills ($GIS), Paychex ($PAYX), H.B. Fuller Company ($FUL), Cintas ($CTAS), and Cracker Barrel ($CBRL). General Mills ($GIS) reported diluted EPS down 67% to $0.74, and adjusted diluted EPS down 13% in constant currency to $0.75, primarily driven by lower operating profit and higher net interest expense.

items.headline: Technology Sector Leads Gains; Financials See Decline
items.summary: The technology sector demonstrated strength, with chip stocks rallying and the Technology Select Sector SPDR ($XLK) adding 2.80% on Monday. In contrast, financial stocks experienced their worst trading day since March on Tuesday.
